checkpoint: Final Evaluation Checkpoint E.1Y — adjudication of the six E.1X failures
purpose: Classifies each E.1X failure as exactly one of: genuine_classification_defect | genuine_action_eligibility_defect | genuine_decision_prompt_defect | evaluation_design_defect, before any production code is changed. E.1X's own labels, scores, and result files are read here but never modified.

adjudications.user_message: Find me a one-way flight and somewhere to stay in Istanbul for next spring -- nothing else for now.
adjudications.missing_essential_fields: No validated trip_request; message names no concrete parseable date ("next spring" is not an ISO date), no origin airport, no traveler count. The internal Travel Search specialist's own per-tool schemas (SearchFlightsArgs/SearchStaysArgs) genuinely cannot be filled from this message.
adjudications.input_guard_requirements: check_input never requires trip_request to be present at all -- narrow single-capability requests are an explicit, existing design allowance (ADR 0013).
adjudications.downstream_specialist_preconditions: Cannot construct a schema-valid search_flights or search_stays call from this message alone.
adjudications.reasoning: E.1X predeclared call_travel_search as the single unambiguous expected action, but essential input for any of the 5 specialist tools is genuinely absent here -- ask_clarification is an equally defensible answer. The eligible action set under the E.1Y policy is {call_travel_search, ask_clarification} both before and after this fix (a validated trip_request was never present in this case) -- the fix does not, and should not, force a single answer here; the E.1X case label itself was over-constrained for a request this open-ended.

adjudications.user_message: Mart ayinda Istanbul icin sadece ucus ve otel ariyorum, baska bir sey degil.
adjudications.missing_essential_fields: No validated trip_request; "Mart ayinda" ("in March") is a month name, not a concrete date; no year, origin, or traveler count.
adjudications.input_guard_requirements: Same as V2-S01 -- no rejection for missing trip_request.
adjudications.downstream_specialist_preconditions: Same as V2-S01 -- no specialist tool can be validly constructed from this message alone.
adjudications.reasoning: Identical structural pattern to V2-S01. eligible_action_set under E.1Y remains {call_travel_search, ask_clarification} -- unchanged by this fix, correctly so.

adjudications.user_message: Aslinda gezilecek yerleri bos ver, sadece ucus bulmama yardim et.
adjudications.missing_essential_fields: No validated trip_request; no date, origin, destination, or traveler count anywhere in the message or prior state -- even less concrete than V2-S01/V2-S03.
adjudications.downstream_specialist_preconditions: Same as above -- cannot construct a valid specialist call.
adjudications.reasoning: Same pattern, explicit-scope-change variant. eligible_action_set under E.1Y remains {call_travel_search, ask_clarification} -- unchanged by this fix, correctly so.

adjudications.user_message: أريد الآن معلومات عن رحلة مختلفة تمامًا لشهر ديسمبر.
adjudications.missing_essential_fields: No validated trip_request and no concrete date ("December" is a month, not an ISO date) -- same parameter-level incompleteness as V2-S01/03/04, but the failure here is upstream of eligibility entirely.
adjudications.input_guard_requirements: N/A -- message accepted, failure is in capability classification.
adjudications.downstream_specialist_preconditions: N/A -- scope itself was misclassified before eligibility was ever computed.
adjudications.reasoning: Unlike the other three, the SCOPE itself was misclassified to clarification_required (eligible_action_set was EMPTY of any specialist option at all -- not even co-eligible). The request is unambiguously travel-related (a flight, for December); the task itself is not ambiguous, only its parameters are -- E.1W's classifier prompt did not clearly distinguish task-level ambiguity (-> clarification_required) from parameter-level incompleteness within an otherwise-clear task (-> the evidence-needing scope itself, since gathering evidence is exactly what resolves parameter gaps). This is a genuine, generic defect in the classifier's own precedence rules, not specific to this case's exact wording, and not something the E.1W fix already covered (E.1W addressed cross-turn continuity, not this task-vs-parameter distinction) -- the classifier prompt is amended with one generic precedence clarification (see production changes).

adjudications.user_message: Devam et, bana biraz daha gosterecek yer soyle.
adjudications.missing_essential_fields: None -- call_istanbul_expert's own argument schema (CallIstanbulExpertArgs) requires only a free-text question, which the supervisor can always construct; nothing concrete was ever missing here.
adjudications.input_guard_requirements: N/A -- no structured data ever required for this specialist action.
adjudications.downstream_specialist_preconditions: None -- the Istanbul Expert specialist never needs structured trip_request fields.
adjudications.reasoning: Scope classification was CORRECT (istanbul_local_only) and the pre-E.1Y eligible_action_set already correctly excluded call_istanbul_expert-as-not-eligible reasoning -- the real defect was that `ask_clarification` was unconditionally available to the model regardless of this state (the old caller-side union), giving the model a free, always-legal escape hatch even though nothing was actually missing. Fixed directly by moving ask_clarification out of the unconditional union and into the deterministic policy, which now correctly excludes it for istanbul_local_only.

adjudications.user_message: أكمل من فضلك حتى لو تعذر الحصول على إجابة الدليل المحلي.
adjudications.missing_essential_fields: None applicable -- a terminal (failed) observation already exists; the question is synthesis-vs-degradation, not missing input.
adjudications.downstream_specialist_preconditions: N/A -- specialist work already completed (unsuccessfully) this turn.
adjudications.output_degradation_contract_determinatio: Authoritative: `_synthesize_node` already turns ANY state with at least one observation (even an all-failed one) into an honest "partial" status, never blocking on failure -- `_degrade_node` is reached only via an explicitly model-selected `degrade` action or a structural bound/cancellation/classification-failure path, never automatically from a failed observation. Per this existing, unmodified contract, synthesize (yielding "partial") is authoritative here, not degrade.
adjudications.reasoning: Exactly like V2-S09's pattern but for `degrade`: the eligibility computation already correctly restricted the scope-based policy to {synthesize}, but `degrade` was STILL unconditionally available via the old caller-side union, so the model exercised that always-available escape hatch instead of the honest partial synthesis the existing output contract already prescribes. Fixed the same way: degrade is now eligible only for out_of_scope or a failed classification with no safe fallback -- never merely because one piece of evidence failed while a real observation still exists.
